answer: A verdict only settles when 2 independent verifiers reach the same tier, and the payout is withheld until they do. A farm that owns the submitting key cannot also own the verifiers, because each one must be independent on the thread graph and each exposes its bond to the vault slash if it rubber-stamps. Since disagreement costs everyone the epoch, the tundra audit records every split and the operator cannot buy agreement cheaply. That is 34 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
